def solve(case):
    lines = case["lines"]
    trajectory = []
    valid = True
    error_line = None
    allowed_types = {"Thought", "Action", "Observation", "Final"}
    previous_type = None
    for i, line in enumerate(lines, start=1):
        parts = line.split(": ", 1)
        if len(parts) != 2:
            error_line = i
            valid = False
            break
        prefix, content = parts
        if prefix not in allowed_types:
            error_line = i
            valid = False
            break
        # sequence validation
        if previous_type is None:
            if prefix != "Thought":
                error_line = i
                valid = False
                break
        elif previous_type == "Thought":
            if prefix != "Action":
                error_line = i
                valid = False
                break
        elif previous_type == "Action":
            if prefix != "Observation":
                error_line = i
                valid = False
                break
        elif previous_type == "Observation":
            if prefix not in ["Thought", "Final"]:
                error_line = i
                valid = False
                break
        # if Final, ensure it's the last line
        if prefix == "Final" and i != len(lines):
            error_line = i
            valid = False
            break
        trajectory.append({"type": prefix, "content": content})
        previous_type = prefix
    # after loop, check if sequence ended properly
    if valid and previous_type != "Final":
        valid = False
        error_line = len(lines)  # last line is incomplete
    return {"error_line": error_line, "trajectory": trajectory, "valid": valid}
